| Number | Letter |
| :--- | :--- |

| **0** | o |
| **7** | t |
| **2** | r |
| **3** | e |
| **1** | l |
| **9** | g |

| Leetspeak | Plaintext |
| :--- | :--- |

| **y0u** | you |

| **f149** | flag |****

### 7. *@F DA:? >6 C:89E C@F?5 323J C:89E C@F?5 Wcf E:>6DX

In this first we need to identify the cipher:
- Letters.
- Numbers.
- Special characters.
- Symbols such as ``@``, ``?``, ``>`` and ``W``.


So in this it look different from **ROT13**, **ROT13** only changes letters.

So in this we can idenify it's **ROT47** changes printable ASCII characters, including letters, numbers and symbols.


In this open: https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/

Past:
````
*@F DA:? >6 C:89E C@F?5 323J C:89E C@F?5 Wcf E:>6DX
````

<img width="1867" height="957" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15a66e37-193d-4fcb-87fc-01fa03a94d10" />



Now we see plaintext:
````
You spin me right round baby right round (47 times)
````
<img width="1581" height="138" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d38aa0dd-41af-4950-869c-b51be4d5a29d" />

So in it as:
````mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start(["Original Long String"])
    S1["1. Base64<br/>Decode the original long string"]
    S2["2. Morse Code<br/>Decode the Base64 output"]
    S3["3. Binary<br/>Convert binary into text"]
    S4["4. ROT47<br/>Rotate printable ASCII characters"]
    S5["5. Decimal to ASCII<br/>Convert decimal values into characters"]
    End(["Final Flag"])

    Start --> S1
    S1 --> S2
    S2 --> S3
    S3 --> S4
    S4 --> S5
    S5 --> End

    %% Styling

    classDef step fill:#2d3748,stroke:#4a5568,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff;

    class Start,End startEnd;
    class S1,S2,S3,S4,S5 step;
````

## Task 2: Spectrograms

A spectrogram is a visual representation of the spectrum of frequencies of a signal as it varies with time. When applied to an audio signal, spectrograms are sometimes called sonographs, voiceprints, or voicegrams. When the data is represented in a 3D plot they may be called waterfalls.
